entries.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says

entries.snippet: Western officials stress that any force sent to Ukraine would not take part in any offensive operations.

entries.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president

entries.snippet: The attack on Donovan Marx, 50, comes as right-wing groups say there is a genocide of white people - a claim widely discredited.

entries.title: Wizz Air flight from Luton in emergency landing after bomb threat
entries.snippet: A Hungarian fighter jet escorted the aircraft to Budapest after the threat was received mid-air.

entries.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
entries.snippet: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

entries.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
entries.snippet: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.

entries.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
entries.snippet: Uganda has been helping Somalia battle an insurgency led by the al-Shabab militant group since 2007.

entries.title: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
entries.snippet: China Media Group, which acknowledged Mbappé's apology, has not said how long the blackout will last.

entries.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
entries.snippet: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.

entries.title: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences
entries.snippet: The author of Jasper Jones and Runt pleaded guilty in May after police raided his home months earlier.

entries.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
entries.snippet: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

entries.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
entries.snippet: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

entries.title: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
entries.snippet: Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.

entries.title: Is America really that polarized? The answer might be a surprise
entries.snippet: The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.

entries.title: Judge accuses DOJ of 'weaponization,' tosses case against ex-FBI officials
entries.snippet: The judge said he was "deeply troubled" by the mistakes and rushed nature of the case over the FBI's Hunter Biden probes — one of several politically charged DOJ actions ahead of the midterms.

entries.title: The Supreme Court rejects a DOJ push to separate California ballots
entries.snippet: The U.S. Supreme Court has denied a last-minute request from the Department of Justice to wade into its unprecedented feud with California over the state's voter rolls.

entries.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
entries.snippet: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

entries.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
entries.snippet: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

entries.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
entries.snippet: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?

entries.title: 6 things to watch for on election night
entries.snippet: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.

entries.title: With students scarce, college admissions offices get friendlier, less intimidating
entries.snippet: Colleges are trying to transform an admissions process that has often been daunting, secretive and stressful into an experience that's open, easier — and downright friendly.

entries.title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
entries.snippet: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

entries.title: Where the battle for Congress stands heading into Election Day

entries.title: Advocates warn Afghans deported by U.S. will face 'certain death' under Taliban
entries.snippet: The Trump administration is preparing to deport at least 150 Afghans over the next 48 hours, first to Pakistan and then to Taliban-controlled Afghanistan. Many of those facing deportation are relatives of those who worked alongside the United States. They could face severe retali

entries.title: Surprise endorsement in Michigan Senate race a 'huge distraction,' says Rep. Dingell
entries.snippet: Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens' decision to back Republican Mike Rogers in the U.S. Senate race has sent shockwaves through the Democratic Party. To discuss the shifting dynamics in the Senate race, Amna Nawaz spoke with Michigan Democratic Congresswoman Debbie Dingell.

entries.title: Muslim communities confront surge of hostility during midterms
entries.snippet: In the run-up to the midterm elections, experts have documented a surge of Islamophobia in political ads and speeches. Special correspondent Fred de Sam Lazaro reports on some of the targets of that rhetoric and the impact it's making. It's part of our series, Race Matters.

entries.title: Palm Beach plane crash footage isn't AI-generated, despite social media claims
entries.snippet: Footage from Palm Beach County, Florida, shows a plane nosediving into the ground at full speed. It looks unreal. So unreal that some social media users say it's fake.

entries.title: Why health insurance premiums are rising, according to experts
entries.snippet: Annual premiums for employer-provided healthcare coverage are expected to rise sharply next year, with workers shouldering more of the costs.

entries.title: Washington state resident dies from bird flu following exposure to infected cattle
entries.snippet: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says the risk to the general public is low and urges precautions for those in contact with sick or dead birds.

entries.title: Flash flooding triggers evacuations in Southwest and a dire warning for a Colorado spa town
entries.snippet: Heavy rains and flash flooding have prompted mandatory evacuation orders in parts of the U.S. Southwest.

entries.title: Is El Niño making storms and flash floods in the Southwest worse?
entries.snippet: Experts say the natural warming cycle is sizzling Pacific Ocean waters and leaking moisture into the air that can fuel passing storms.

entries.title: Karl Bushby embraces his mother as he completes his 28-year walk around world
entries.snippet: Bushby was a 29-year-old ex-paratrooper when he began his journey from Punta Arenas, Chile, on Nov. 1, 1998. He walked 31,000 miles across four continents and 30 countries.

entries.title: Initial results suggest Iliana Yotova wins runoff to become Bulgaria's 1st elected female president
entries.snippet: Former interim Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov conceded defeat.

entries.title: In an Alaska fishing community, the Dan Sullivan episode takes an ominous turn
entries.snippet: In Petersburg, Alaska, nobody has seen Dan J. Sullivan for weeks. Sullivan's rustic home stood dark a day after FBI agents paid a visit to friends who donated to his campaign to unseat the Republican senator with the same first and last name.

entries.title: ICE officer charged with ramming man with SUV in Houston turns himself in
entries.snippet: Mario Alberto Morales made his first court appearance Monday on a felony charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon for striking Miguel Parra Hernandez with an unmarked SUV on Oct. 10.

entries.title: Parts of a Learjet may have broken off midair before Florida crash that killed 9, investigators say
entries.snippet: National Transportation Safety Board member Tom Chapman said Monday that evidence found at the crash site indicates the aircraft started to break up in the air and that debris could be found far from the crash site.

entries.title: Voters on the left and right fear the America they've known is slipping away
entries.snippet: Whether they're from the left or the right, they're worried that the America they've known is slipping away. They see the political class stirring up anger and hate and turning neighbors against each other.

entries.title: What to know about the Affordable Care Act's open enrollment period
entries.snippet: People signing up for health insurance coverage under the Affordable Care Act for 2027 should expect higher premiums and fewer options. The enrollment period starts Sunday and ends in mid-January.

entries.title: Trump administration promised farmers $15 billion in weeks before midterms
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's administration has made $15 billion worth of promises to agriculture producers in the last few weeks before the midterm elections.

entries.title: Kennedy Center names 2026 honorees as Trump renovation battle moves show offsite
entries.snippet: The Kennedy Center has announced that Paul Anka, David Foster, Andy Garcia, David Mamet and Barbara Mandrell will be honored at this year's Kennedy Center Honors.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to block 20,000 California ballots
entries.snippet: The Trump administration had appealed to the Supreme Court over claims that a list of more than 20,000 ballots in California include non-US citizens.

entries.title: Ukraine: At least 26 killed in Russian strikes on aid center
entries.snippet: At least 26 people were killed in Russian airstrikes on a school that was serving as an aid distribution center in Zaporizhzhia, a southern Ukrainian region. DW has more.

entries.title: US to drop South Africa, Rwanda from duty-free trade initiative
entries.snippet: The Trump administration has said South Africa and Rwanda are breaking the rules of the AGOA free trade initiative, a centerpiece of US economic engagement with sub-Saharan Africa.

entries.title: France: Petition to ban TV channel gets 500,000 signatures
entries.snippet: Support for the petition has surged since last month's shooting of a Black man by a reported avid viewer of CNews. Critics say the channel, often compared to Fox News, is a platform for anti-immigrant sentiments.

entries.title: What might Trump have planned for Iran following the midterm election?
entries.snippet: While the US midterms could open a window for diplomacy with Iran, they could also unleash a new military escalation. DW spoke with analysts to identify eight factors that could tip the balance toward war or peace.

entries.title: Ice hockey officials considering options after CAS order to reinstate Russia
entries.snippet: Ice hockey's ruling body is deciding how to respond to a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport that allows Russia back into international competition. Germany hasn't ruled out pulling out as a tournament host.

entries.title: European supermarkets targeted in second reported cyberattack
entries.snippet: Supermarkets across Europe have been targeted in cyberattacks once again. Three weeks after a defrosting attack in France, supermarkets in Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Luxembourg and Sweden reported freezer malfunctions.

entries.title: LA communities kick out Big Oil
entries.snippet: After years of advocacy from residents and legal battles with Big Oil, Los Angeles voted to ban drilling and phase out oil extraction in the city. It's the first city in the United States to kick the oil industry out.

entries.title: Germany's chancellor called for Korean unity. Does Seoul want that?
entries.snippet: Germany, like Korea, was once divided by rival political systems and by one of the world's most fortified borders. Chancellor Merz called for a reunified Korea during his recent visit — but the prospect seems faint.

entries.title: Global pedestrian Karl Bushby returns home to UK after 28-year trek
entries.snippet: Karl Bushby, a British man who traveled 50,000 km without transport over the past 28 years, has come home. Starting in Chile, he crossed the Americas, Russia and parts of Central Asia and Europe — almost all on foot.

entries.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after two decades
entries.snippet: Ugandan troops first deployed to Somalia in 2007 as part of an international military coalition to battle Islamic insurgents. But the mission has faced mounting pressure since a US decision to withdraw funding.

entries.title: How Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria
entries.snippet: Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria, promising to be a "president of peace." But the campaign showed how divided Bulgarians are about the war in Ukraine and drone attacks in the Black Sea.

entries.title: Will renewed conflict derail Ethiopia's economic growth?
entries.snippet: Ethiopia's economy is growing strongly. But renewed fighting in the north of the BRICS member state could deter investment, strain public finances and push up the cost of living.

entries.title: For US Democrats, climate policy is now about energy bills
entries.snippet: Climate change has all but disappeared from Democrats' campaign pitches, replaced by promises to lower electricity bills. So what would the party really do for climate policy should it win control of Congress?

entries.title: US: 9 killed in Florida jet crash
entries.snippet: A Learjet plane crashed near a busy road in a residential neighborhood in Palm Beach County, leaving all nine people on board dead and a large crater on ground.

entries.title: Merz says next German president 'must be a woman' — report
entries.snippet: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier's second term is due to end in March next year. Meanwhile, Merz has called for 'digital sovereignty' in the era of AI.

entries.title: India news: Gandhi vows to step up pressure on Modi at protest rally
entries.snippet: Rahul Gandhi said the removal of election chief Gyanesh Kumar will be the first step to getting the country on the right track. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Kimi Antonelli makes history as youngest F1 champion
entries.snippet: Kimi Antonelli became Formula One's youngest world champion and Italy's first since 1953 when he finished third in Sunday's thrilling and crash-hit Mexico City Grand Prix.

entries.title: South Korea to pour billions into AI
entries.snippet: President Lee Jae Myung has presented his record-breaking budget proposal for 2027, including major investments in AI and other tech.
